nathanael_2158.name: Nathanael
nathanael_2158.who: A disciple from Cana in Galilee whom Philip brought to Jesus.
key: Philip told him they had found the one Moses wrote about, Jesus of Nazareth (John 1).
He doubted that anything good could come from Nazareth (John 1).
Jesus called him an Israelite without deceit and said he saw him under the fig tree (John 1).
He confessed Jesus as the Son of God and the King of Israel (John 1).
He was fishing with other disciples when the risen Jesus appeared at the Sea of Tiberias (John 21).

obadiah_2215.name: Obadiah
obadiah_2215.who: The steward over King Ahab's household who greatly feared the Lord.
key: He hid a hundred of the Lord's prophets in caves and fed them during Jezebel's purge (1 Kings 18).
While searching for grass during the famine, he met Elijah on the road (1 Kings 18).
Afraid Ahab would kill him, he hesitated before reporting Elijah's arrival (1 Kings 18).
He told Ahab, who then went to meet Elijah (1 Kings 18).

obed_2228.name: Obed
obed_2228.who: The son of Boaz and Ruth, father of Jesse and grandfather of King David.
key: He was born to Boaz and Ruth, and Naomi cared for him (Ruth 4).
The neighborhood women named him and called him a son born to Naomi (Ruth 4).
He is listed in the line of Judah leading to David (1 Chronicles 2).
He appears in the genealogy of Jesus Christ (Matthew 1).

onan_2250.name: Onan
onan_2250.who: The second son of Judah, whom the Lord put to death for his wickedness.
key: He was born to Judah and the daughter of Shua, a Canaanite (Genesis 38).
Judah told him to raise up offspring for his dead brother Er through Tamar (Genesis 38).
He refused to give his brother offspring, and the Lord put him to death (Genesis 38).
He is listed among Judah's sons who died in Canaan (Genesis 46).

othniel_2259.name: Othniel
othniel_2259.who: The son of Kenaz from Judah who became Israel's first judge after Joshua.
key: He captured Kiriath-sepher and received Caleb's daughter Achsah as his wife (Joshua 15).
His capture of the city and marriage to Achsah are recounted again (Judges 1).
The Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he defeated Cushan-rishathaim of Mesopotamia (Judges 3).
The land had rest forty years until Othniel died (Judges 3).
His sons Hathath and Meonothai are listed in Judah's genealogy (1 Chronicles 4).

phinehas_2350.name: Phinehas
phinehas_2350.who: A son of Eli who served as a priest at Shiloh but treated the Lord's offering with contempt.
key: He and his brother Hophni served as priests of the Lord at Shiloh (1 Samuel 1).
The brothers took sacrifices wrongly, lay with women at the tabernacle, and ignored their father (1 Samuel 2).
A man of God foretold that Hophni and Phinehas would both die on one day (1 Samuel 2).
He was killed when the Philistines captured the ark, and his wife died bearing Ichabod (1 Samuel 4).

priscilla_2370.name: Priscilla
priscilla_2370.who: A Jewish Christian woman who, with her husband Aquila, worked and ministered alongside Paul.
key: Expelled from Rome under Claudius, she and Aquila welcomed Paul in Corinth as fellow tentmakers (Acts 18).
She and Aquila explained the way of God more accurately to Apollos in Ephesus (Acts 18).
Paul greeted them as fellow workers who risked their necks for his life (Romans 16).
A church met in the house of Aquila and Prisca (1 Corinthians 16).
Paul sent them greetings in his final letter (2 Timothy 4).

ram_2391.name: Ram
ram_2391.who: A son of Hezron from Judah, the father of Amminadab and an ancestor of David and Jesus.
key: He is listed in the line from Perez to David (Ruth 4).
He is named among the sons of Hezron in Judah's genealogy (1 Chronicles 2).
He appears in the genealogy of Jesus Christ (Matthew 1).

reu_2428.name: Reu
reu_2428.who: A descendant of Shem, the son of Peleg and the father of Serug.
key: He fathered Serug at thirty-two and lived 239 years in all (Genesis 11).
He is listed in the line from Shem to Abraham (1 Chronicles 1).
He appears in Luke's genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

reuel_2430.name: Reuel
reuel_2430.who: A son of Esau by Basemath and ancestor of chiefs in Edom.
key: He was born to Esau and Basemath in the land of Canaan (Genesis 36).
His sons Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah became chiefs in Edom (Genesis 36).
He is listed among Esau's sons (1 Chronicles 1).

salmon_2463.name: Salmon
salmon_2463.who: The son of Nahshon and father of Boaz, an ancestor of King David and Jesus.
key: He is listed in the line from Perez to David (Ruth 4).
He appears in Judah's genealogy as the father of Boaz (1 Chronicles 2).
Matthew records that he fathered Boaz by Rahab (Matthew 1).
He appears in Luke's genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

serug_2503.name: Serug
serug_2503.who: A descendant of Shem, the son of Reu and the father of Nahor.
key: He fathered Nahor at thirty and lived 230 years in all (Genesis 11).
He is listed in the line from Shem to Abraham (1 Chronicles 1).
He appears in Luke's genealogy of Jesus (Luke 3).

shishak_2712.name: Shishak
shishak_2712.who: A king of Egypt who sheltered Jeroboam and later invaded Judah.
key: Jeroboam fled to Shishak in Egypt to escape Solomon (1 Kings 11).
In Rehoboam's fifth year he attacked Jerusalem and took the temple and palace treasures (1 Kings 14).
He carried off the gold shields Solomon had made (1 Kings 14).
After Rehoboam humbled himself, the Lord did not let Shishak destroy Jerusalem completely (2 Chronicles 12).

tilgath-pilneser_2376.name: Tiglath-pileser
tilgath-pilneser_2376.who: A king of Assyria who invaded Israel and took many Israelites into exile.
key: In Pekah's reign he captured cities of Naphtali and carried the people to Assyria (2 Kings 15).
Ahaz sent him tribute; he captured Damascus and killed King Rezin (2 Kings 16).
He carried away the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh (1 Chronicles 5).
He came against Ahaz and afflicted him rather than strengthening him (2 Chronicles 28).

zechariah_3016.name: Zechariah
zechariah_3016.who: A prophet after the exile, son of Berechiah and grandson of Iddo, who urged rebuilding the temple.
key: He and Haggai prophesied to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem (Ezra 5).
The elders finished the temple, prospering through the prophesying of Haggai and Zechariah (Ezra 6).
In Darius's second year the Lord called the people through him to return to him (Zechariah 1).
He answered a question about fasting with a call to justice, kindness, and mercy (Zechariah 7).

zephaniah_3039.name: Zephaniah
zephaniah_3039.who: A priest, son of Maaseiah, in Jerusalem during King Zedekiah's reign.
key: Zedekiah sent him to Jeremiah to inquire of the Lord about Nebuchadnezzar (Jeremiah 21).
He read to Jeremiah a letter from Shemaiah demanding Jeremiah be confined (Jeremiah 29).
Zedekiah again sent him to ask Jeremiah to pray for the people (Jeremiah 37).
As second priest, he was captured by Nebuzaradan and executed at Riblah (2 Kings 25).

abidan_22.name: Abidan
abidan_22.who: The son of Gideoni and chief of the tribe of Benjamin in the wilderness.
key: Named chief of the tribe of Benjamin to help Moses take the census (Numbers 1).
Led the army of Benjamin in its assigned place around the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
Brought Benjamin's offering for the altar's dedication on the ninth day (Numbers 7).
Commanded Benjamin's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

abiel_23.name: Abiel
abiel_23.who: A Benjaminite, the son of Zeror, and grandfather of King Saul through Kish.
key: He is named as the father of Kish, a wealthy Benjaminite and Saul's father (1 Samuel 9).
Kish, Saul's father, and Ner, Abner's father, are called sons of Abiel (1 Samuel 14).

abinadab_641.name: Abinadab
abinadab_641.who: A son of King Saul who died with his father in battle against the Philistines.
key: He is listed among the sons of Saul (1 Chronicles 8).
The Philistines killed him with Jonathan and Malchi-shua on Mount Gilboa (1 Samuel 31).
His death alongside Saul and his brothers is recorded again (1 Chronicles 10).

abishag_49.name: Abishag
abishag_49.who: A young woman from Shunem who attended King David in his old age.
key: She was chosen to care for the aged David and keep him warm (1 Kings 1).
She was attending the king when Bathsheba came to speak about Adonijah (1 Kings 1).
Adonijah asked through Bathsheba to marry her, and Solomon had him executed (1 Kings 2).

adoniram_102.name: Adoniram
adoniram_102.who: The son of Abda who oversaw forced labor under David, Solomon, and Rehoboam.
key: He was in charge of the forced labor under David (2 Samuel 20).
He is listed among Solomon's high officials (1 Kings 4).
He supervised thirty thousand laborers sent in shifts to Lebanon (1 Kings 5).
Rehoboam sent him to Israel, and the people stoned him to death (1 Kings 12).

agag_109.name: Agag
agag_109.who: A king of the Amalekites whom Saul spared against the Lord's command.
key: Saul captured Agag alive and spared him along with the best livestock (1 Samuel 15).
Samuel rebuked Saul, saying the Lord had rejected him as king (1 Samuel 15).
Samuel put Agag to death before the Lord at Gilgal (1 Samuel 15).

ahiezer_131.name: Ahiezer
ahiezer_131.who: The son of Ammishaddai and chief of the tribe of Dan in the wilderness.
key: Named chief of the tribe of Dan to help Moses take the census (Numbers 1).
Led the army of Dan in its assigned place around the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
Brought Dan's offering for the altar's dedication on the tenth day (Numbers 7).
Commanded Dan's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

ahilud_142.name: Ahilud
ahilud_142.who: The father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder, and of Baana, one of Solomon's officers.
key: His son Jehoshaphat served as recorder in David's court (2 Samuel 8).
Jehoshaphat is again listed as recorder among David's officials (2 Samuel 20).
His sons Jehoshaphat and Baana served among Solomon's officials (1 Kings 4).

ahira_157.name: Ahira
ahira_157.who: The son of Enan and chief of the tribe of Naphtali in the wilderness.
key: Named chief of the tribe of Naphtali to help Moses take the census (Numbers 1).
Led the army of Naphtali in its assigned place around the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
Brought Naphtali's offering for the altar's dedication on the twelfth day (Numbers 7).
Commanded Naphtali's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

ahitub_163.name: Ahitub
ahitub_163.who: A priest, grandson of Eli through Phinehas, and father of Ahijah and Ahimelech.
key: His son Ahijah served as priest, wearing the ephod, with Saul's army (1 Samuel 14).
Saul summoned his son Ahimelech and the priests of his house, and Doeg killed them (1 Samuel 22).

ahitub_164.name: Ahitub
ahitub_164.who: A priest descended from Aaron, the son of Amariah and father of Zadok.
key: His son Zadok served as priest under David (2 Samuel 8).
He is listed in the priestly line of Eleazar son of Aaron (1 Chronicles 6).
Zadok son of Ahitub is again named among David's officials (1 Chronicles 18).

aholiab_170.name: Oholiab
aholiab_170.who: A craftsman from the tribe of Dan who assisted Bezalel in building the tabernacle.
key: The Lord appointed him, son of Ahisamach, to work with Bezalel (Exodus 31).
God gave him and Bezalel skill and the ability to teach others (Exodus 35).
He worked with the skilled craftsmen on the sanctuary (Exodus 36).
He served as an engraver, designer, and embroiderer in fine fabrics (Exodus 38).

aholibah_171.name: Oholibah
aholibah_171.who: A symbolic name for Jerusalem in Ezekiel's parable of two unfaithful sisters.
key: God pictures Jerusalem as Oholibah, sister of Oholah (Samaria), to condemn her idolatry (Ezekiel 23).
She is judged for growing more corrupt than her sister (Ezekiel 23).

aholibamah_1761.name: Oholibamah
aholibamah_1761.who: One of Esau's wives, a Canaanite woman descended from Zibeon the Hivite.
key: Esau took her as a wife from the Canaanite women (Genesis 36).
She bore Esau three sons, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah, in Canaan (Genesis 36).
Her sons became chiefs among Esau's descendants (Genesis 36).

akkub_181.name: Akkub
akkub_181.who: A Levite gatekeeper whose name also marks a family of gatekeepers after the exile.
key: He is listed among the gatekeepers who lived in Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 9).
The sons of Akkub were among the gatekeepers who returned from exile (Ezra 2).
Akkub and Talmon guarded the gates as gatekeepers in Jerusalem (Nehemiah 11).
Akkub is named among gatekeepers guarding the storehouses at the gates (Nehemiah 12).

ammishaddai_230.name: Ammishaddai
ammishaddai_230.who: A man of the tribe of Dan, the father of Ahiezer, Dan's chief in the wilderness.
key: He is named as the father of Ahiezer, chief of Dan, at the census (Numbers 1).
His son Ahiezer led Dan's army north of the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
His son brought Dan's offering for the altar's dedication (Numbers 7).
His son commanded Dan's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

anah_248.name: Anah
anah_248.who: A son of Seir the Horite and one of the Horite chiefs in Edom.
key: He is listed among the sons of Seir, the original inhabitants of the land (Genesis 36).
He is named among the chiefs of the Horites in Seir (Genesis 36).
He appears again among the sons of Seir (1 Chronicles 1).

ananias_259.name: Ananias
ananias_259.who: A disciple in Damascus whom the Lord sent to restore Saul's sight.
key: In a vision, the Lord sent him to Saul, though he feared Saul's reputation (Acts 9).
He laid hands on Saul, who regained his sight and was baptized (Acts 9).
Paul later described him as devout and well spoken of by the Jews (Acts 22).
He told Paul that God had chosen him to be a witness to all people (Acts 22).

aristarchus_306.name: Aristarchus
aristarchus_306.who: A Macedonian from Thessalonica who traveled with Paul and shared his imprisonment.
key: The rioting crowd in Ephesus seized him and Gaius, Paul's companions (Acts 19).
He accompanied Paul on his journey from Greece toward Jerusalem (Acts 20).
He sailed with Paul on the voyage to Rome (Acts 27).
Paul called him his fellow prisoner and sent his greetings (Colossians 4).
Paul named him among his fellow workers (Philemon 1).

asshur_349.name: Asshur
asshur_349.who: A son of Shem whose name is linked with the people of Assyria.
key: He is listed among the sons of Shem in the table of nations (Genesis 10).
He appears again among Shem's sons (1 Chronicles 1).

azariah_545.name: Azariah
azariah_545.who: A young man of Judah taken to Babylon with Daniel and renamed Abednego.
key: Taken to Babylon, he was chosen for royal training and renamed Abednego (Daniel 1).
He joined Daniel in refusing the king's food and proved healthier after ten days (Daniel 1).
Daniel asked him and his friends to seek God's mercy about the king's dream (Daniel 2).
At Daniel's request, he was appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon (Daniel 2).

benaiah_442.name: Benaiah
benaiah_442.who: A Levite musician appointed when David brought the ark of God to Jerusalem.
key: He was appointed among the Levite musicians to play harps (1 Chronicles 15).
He served in the music as the ark was brought up to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 15).
He was appointed to minister before the ark with harps and lyres (1 Chronicles 16).

beriah_478.name: Beriah
beriah_478.who: A son of Asher and ancestor of the Beriite clan.
key: He went down to Egypt with Jacob's family (Genesis 46).
His descendants formed the clan of the Beriites (Numbers 26).
His sons Heber and Malchiel are listed in Asher's genealogy (1 Chronicles 7).

bildad_499.name: Bildad
bildad_499.who: Bildad the Shuhite, one of Job's three friends who came to comfort him.
key: He came with Eliphaz and Zophar to comfort Job (Job 2).
He insisted God does not pervert justice and urged Job to seek him (Job 8).
He described the terrible end of the wicked (Job 18).
He asked how a man can be righteous before God (Job 25).
God rebuked the friends and accepted Job's prayer for them after their offering (Job 42).

chedorlaomer_926.name: Chedorlaomer
chedorlaomer_926.who: A king of Elam who led an alliance of kings in the days of Abram.
key: Several kings served him twelve years and rebelled in the thirteenth (Genesis 14).
He and his allies defeated the kings of the valley and captured Lot (Genesis 14).
Abram pursued with his trained men and defeated him, rescuing Lot (Genesis 14).

cushi_964.name: The Cushite
cushi_964.who: The runner Joab sent to report Absalom's death to King David.
key: Joab sent him to tell David what he had seen (2 Samuel 18).
Ahimaaz ran after him and outran him (2 Samuel 18).
He told David that Absalom was dead, and the king wept (2 Samuel 18).

daughter_of_pharaoh_989.name: Daughter of Pharaoh
daughter_of_pharaoh_989.who: The Egyptian princess whom Solomon married.
key: Solomon made a marriage alliance with Pharaoh and brought her into the city of David (1 Kings 3).
Solomon built her a house like his Hall of Judgment (1 Kings 7).
Pharaoh gave her the city of Gezer as a dowry (1 Kings 9).
She is named among the many foreign women Solomon loved (1 Kings 11).
Solomon moved her out of the city of David because the ark had been there (2 Chronicles 8).

diana_1008.name: Artemis
diana_1008.who: The goddess of the Ephesians, whose worship led to a riot against Paul.
key: Demetrius the silversmith stirred up a riot over Artemis against Paul's preaching (Acts 19).
The crowd shouted praise to Artemis for about two hours (Acts 19).

dishan_1015.name: Dishan
dishan_1015.who: A son of Seir the Horite and a Horite chief in Edom.
key: He is listed among the sons of Seir, inhabitants of the land (Genesis 36).
His sons Uz and Aran are named, and he was a Horite chief (Genesis 36).
He appears again among the sons of Seir (1 Chronicles 1).

ebed_1027.name: Ebed
ebed_1027.who: The father of Gaal, who led the men of Shechem against Abimelech.
key: His son Gaal moved into Shechem, and its leaders put confidence in him (Judges 9).
Gaal challenged Abimelech but was defeated and driven out of Shechem (Judges 9).

ebiasaph_19.name: Ebiasaph
ebiasaph_19.who: A Levite descended from Kohath through Korah, ancestor of singers and gatekeepers.
key: He is listed among the sons of Korah (Exodus 6).
He appears in the Kohathite line leading to Heman the singer (1 Chronicles 6).
He was an ancestor of Shallum, a chief gatekeeper (1 Chronicles 9).
His Korahite descendants served as gatekeepers (1 Chronicles 26).

elam_1052.name: Elam
elam_1052.who: The ancestor of a large family whose descendants returned to Judah after the exile.
key: His descendants, 1,254 in all, returned with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2).
More of his descendants came up from Babylon with Ezra (Ezra 8).
Some of his descendants confessed marrying foreign wives and agreed to put them away (Ezra 10).
His descendants are listed again among the returned exiles (Nehemiah 7).

eliab_1074.name: Eliab
eliab_1074.who: A Reubenite, son of Pallu, and father of Dathan and Abiram, who rebelled against Moses.
key: His sons Dathan and Abiram joined Korah's rebellion against Moses (Numbers 16).
His sons Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram are listed among Reuben's clans (Numbers 26).
Moses recalled how the earth swallowed his sons Dathan and Abiram (Deuteronomy 11).

eliab_1075.name: Eliab
eliab_1075.who: The eldest son of Jesse and older brother of King David.
key: Samuel thought he was the Lord's anointed, but the Lord looks on the heart (1 Samuel 16).
He served in Saul's army facing the Philistines (1 Samuel 17).
He grew angry at David for coming to the battle line (1 Samuel 17).
He is listed as Jesse's firstborn (1 Chronicles 2).
His daughter Abihail was the mother of one of Rehoboam's wives (2 Chronicles 11).

eliasaph_1091.name: Eliasaph
eliasaph_1091.who: The son of Deuel and chief of the tribe of Gad in the wilderness.
key: Named chief of the tribe of Gad to help Moses take the census (Numbers 1).
Led the army of Gad in its assigned place around the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
Brought Gad's offering for the altar's dedication on the sixth day (Numbers 7).
Commanded Gad's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

elizaphan_1189.name: Elizaphan
elizaphan_1189.who: A Levite, son of Uzziel, and chief of the Kohathite clans.
key: He is listed among the sons of Uzziel (Exodus 6).
Moses had him and Mishael carry the bodies of Nadab and Abihu out of the camp (Leviticus 10).
He was chief of the Kohathite clans, who cared for the ark (Numbers 3).
His descendants helped bring the ark to Jerusalem under David (1 Chronicles 15).
His descendants helped cleanse the temple under Hezekiah (2 Chronicles 29).

elizur_1166.name: Elizur
elizur_1166.who: The son of Shedeur and chief of the tribe of Reuben in the wilderness.
key: Named chief of the tribe of Reuben to help Moses take the census (Numbers 1).
Led the army of Reuben in its assigned place around the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
Brought Reuben's offering for the altar's dedication on the fourth day (Numbers 7).
Commanded Reuben's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

enan_1190.name: Enan
enan_1190.who: A man of the tribe of Naphtali, the father of Ahira, Naphtali's chief in the wilderness.
key: He is named as the father of Ahira, chief of Naphtali, at the census (Numbers 1).
His son Ahira led Naphtali's army north of the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
His son brought Naphtali's offering for the altar's dedication (Numbers 7).
His son commanded Naphtali's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

ezer_1238.name: Ezer
ezer_1238.who: A son of Seir the Horite and a Horite chief in Edom.
key: He is listed among the sons of Seir, inhabitants of the land (Genesis 36).
His sons Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan are named, and he was a Horite chief (Genesis 36).
He appears again among the sons of Seir (1 Chronicles 1).

gamaliel_1276.name: Gamaliel
gamaliel_1276.who: The son of Pedahzur and chief of the tribe of Manasseh in the wilderness.
key: Named chief of the tribe of Manasseh to help Moses take the census (Numbers 1).
Led the army of Manasseh in its assigned place around the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
Brought Manasseh's offering for the altar's dedication on the eighth day (Numbers 7).
Commanded Manasseh's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

gershom_1302.name: Gershom
gershom_1302.who: The firstborn son of Moses and Zipporah, born in Midian.
key: Moses named him Gershom, saying he had been a sojourner in a foreign land (Exodus 2).
Jethro brought Zipporah and her two sons to Moses in the wilderness (Exodus 18).
The sons of Moses were counted among the tribe of Levi (1 Chronicles 23).
His descendant Shebuel was chief officer over the temple treasuries (1 Chronicles 26).

gideoni_1315.name: Gideoni
gideoni_1315.who: A man of the tribe of Benjamin, the father of Abidan, Benjamin's chief in the wilderness.
key: He is named as the father of Abidan, chief of Benjamin, at the census (Numbers 1).
His son Abidan led Benjamin's army west of the tabernacle (Numbers 2).
His son brought Benjamin's offering for the altar's dedication (Numbers 7).
His son commanded Benjamin's company when Israel set out from Sinai (Numbers 10).

gomer_1328.name: Gomer
gomer_1328.who: The eldest son of Japheth, whose descendants became a people of the north.
key: He is listed first among the sons of Japheth in the table of nations (Genesis 10).
His sons Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah are named (1 Chronicles 1).
Gomer and its hordes are named among Gog's allies (Ezekiel 38).

hadad_1339.name: Hadad
hadad_1339.who: An Edomite prince whom the Lord raised up as an adversary to Solomon.
key: As a boy he escaped to Egypt when Joab struck down the men of Edom (1 Kings 11).
Pharaoh gave him the sister of Queen Tahpenes as his wife (1 Kings 11).
His son Genubath was raised in Pharaoh's household (1 Kings 11).
After David and Joab died, he returned home and opposed Solomon (1 Kings 11).

haggith_1353.name: Haggith
haggith_1353.who: A wife of King David and the mother of Adonijah.
key: She bore David his fourth son, Adonijah, in Hebron (2 Samuel 3).
Her son Adonijah exalted himself and tried to take the throne (1 Kings 1).
Her son Adonijah was executed after asking for Abishag (1 Kings 2).
She is listed among David's wives who bore him sons in Hebron (1 Chronicles 3).

hammedatha_1362.name: Hammedatha
hammedatha_1362.who: The father of Haman the Agagite, the enemy of the Jews in Persia.
key: His son Haman was promoted above all the officials of King Ahasuerus (Esther 3).
Esther asked the king to revoke the letters devised by his son Haman (Esther 8).
The Jews killed the ten sons of Haman son of Hammedatha (Esther 9).
